name: wifi-control
description: ManageMyWifi — public WiFi network management platform

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:all: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web,agent -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:agent"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wifi-control/shared-types && npm run build -w @wifi-control/validation && npm run build -w @wifi-control/api && npm run build -w @wifi-control/agent && npm run build -w @wifi-control/web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @wifi-control/shared-types && npm run build -w @wifi-control/validation
